review: The closest you can get to the SSS tier. A better part of the Dawn Office duo release. Dawn Faust is a faster-stacking and more damage-dealing version of Gregor who doesn’t buff other allies aside from Dawn Sinclair. She is more self-sufficient and self-focused. Let’s take a closer look at her kit. Starting with her unique effects: - Fire Butterfly Coffin - Just Dawn Faust stacks without extra effects. Gaining 2 on base skill hit, capped at 20 per turn, max 30; at 20+ stacks, she gets Burn equal to half of surplus stack past 20 (rounded down), gaining 5 Burn Potency and 2 Count at 30 stacks instead. Needs 30 for S3-2 and Counter 2. - Overheated Coffin - Burns herself after S3-2. - Battle instinct - Her main self buff passive. It helps her print more stacks of Fire Butterfly Fire Butterfly Coffin (due to passive), gives her 2 haste (for potential everlasting setup) and provides strong dam
